caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright, brown ceramic jar with a rounded body that tapers towards a narrower base and has a wide, flaring rim at the top. The jar features subtle horizontal grooves near the upper portion and along the neck, contributing to its texture and form. The surface has a smooth, slightly glossy appearance with several lighter areas indicating reflected light, while the majority of the body is rendered in various shades of dark brown. The background of the drawing is a uniform, light beige color with no additional objects or details present. The artist's signature, "N. Amartea," appears in small text near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
